key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(de)/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(De).adf:Frontier:5:1969C
name: draw_mask_planes_0123_table
description: Looks up a ten-byte sprite record, shifts its row bytes and ORs them into all four bitplanes for each row of the entry.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(de)/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(De).adf:Frontier:5:196E0
name: draw_mask_planes_0123_span
description: Shifts one source byte per row and ORs it into all four bitplanes over eight rows, stepping twenty bytes per row.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(de)/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(De).adf:Frontier:5:19726
name: draw_mask_planes_0123_row
description: Shifts each source byte of a run by a count and ORs it into all four bitplanes, advancing one destination row per pass.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(de)/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(De).adf:Frontier:5:1974C
name: post_request_record
description: Waits until the pending request flag clears, then writes a command code, a table pointer, a zero and a request count into the request record and marks it pending.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(de)/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(De).adf:Frontier:5:1975E
name: fill_request_record_fields
description: Marks the request record as pending and fills in its table pointer, count and sentinel fields without waiting for the previous request.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(de)/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(De).adf:Frontier:5:1977E
name: wait_for_request_clear
description: Calls a subroutine and then waits until the pending request flag in the device block is cleared.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(de)/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(De).adf:Frontier:5:1978A
name: send_command_and_wait
description: Waits for the pending flag to clear, writes a command code and a zero byte into the request record, calls a subroutine and waits again for completion.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(de)/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(De).adf:Frontier:5:197A6
name: send_alternate_command_wait
description: Waits for the pending flag to clear, writes an alternate command code and a zero byte, calls a subroutine and waits for completion.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(de)/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(De).adf:Frontier:5:197F8
name: call_stored_routine_pointer
description: Calls the routine whose address is stored at the start of the record and returns.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(de)/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(De).adf:Frontier:5:197FE
name: call_four_subroutines
description: Calls four subroutines in sequence and returns.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(de)/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(De).adf:Frontier:5:19818
name: render_text_with_control_codes
description: Draws a zero-terminated text string at a position, drawing printable characters through a glyph routine, treating a control byte as a line feed that advances the baseline by ten, and handling two further control bytes that set the horizontal position or load a value from a table.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(de)/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(De).adf:Frontier:5:19822
name: render_text_string_at_column
description: Draws a zero-terminated string starting at a column, sending printable characters to a glyph routine and handling line-feed and table control bytes the same way as the neighbouring text routine.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(de)/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(De).adf:Frontier:5:19834
name: render_text_from_current_position
description: Draws a zero-terminated string from the current pen position, using a glyph routine for printable characters and control bytes for line feeds and table lookups.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(de)/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(De).adf:Frontier:5:19872
name: parse_text_control_codes
description: Walks a text string byte by byte, separating printable characters from control bytes and sending each control byte to its handler.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(de)/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(De).adf:Frontier:5:19886
name: continue_text_rendering_loop
description: Continues the text loop from the stored pointer, drawing printable characters through a glyph routine and stopping at the terminator.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(de)/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(De).adf:Frontier:5:19890
name: dispatch_text_control_bytes
description: Dispatches a control byte to the line-feed, horizontal-position or table-lookup handler and resumes the text loop at the next byte.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(de)/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(De).adf:Frontier:5:198B2
name: advance_text_line_and_render
description: Moves the pen down a line, then renders the next run of characters from the string through the glyph routine until the terminator or the vertical limit.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(de)/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(De).adf:Frontier:5:198C2
name: append_text_until_terminator
description: Stores a table pointer and position word into the record and walks a zero-terminated string until its terminator is reached.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(de)/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(De).adf:Frontier:5:19924
name: skip_text_control_bytes
description: Walks a text string, stepping over the operand bytes that follow each control code and loading a value from a table for one code, until the terminator is reached.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(de)/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(De).adf:Frontier:5:19938
name: advance_past_text_string
description: Advances the string pointer one byte at a time until it reaches the zero terminator, leaving it on the terminator.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(de)/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(De).adf:Frontier:5:19942
name: store_text_table_entries
description: Walks a control-coded text string and, for one control byte, loads a table word into the output record while drawing nothing.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(de)/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(De).adf:Frontier:5:19964
name: seek_text_terminator_forward
description: Steps forward through the string until the zero terminator is found, without any other processing.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(de)/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(De).adf:Frontier:5:19970
name: sort_edge_coordinate_pairs
description: Sorts pairs of screen coordinates into ascending order, then steps two edge positions and calls a row routine for each span that falls within the screen width.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(de)/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(De).adf:Frontier:5:199B2
name: compute_fixed_point_edge_slope
description: Divides the horizontal difference by the vertical difference to get a fixed-point step for an edge, corrects the rounding for negative values and stores the step as the edge increment.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(de)/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(De).adf:Frontier:5:199B8
name: compute_second_edge_slope
description: Computes the fixed-point step for the second edge from the horizontal and vertical differences, applying the same sign-corrected rounding.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(de)/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(De).adf:Frontier:5:199E4
name: fill_triangle_scanlines
description: Steps two edges down the scanlines and, for each row whose span lies within the screen width, calls a row-drawing routine selected from a table.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(de)/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(De).adf:Frontier:5:199EA
name: fill_scanlines_second_edge
description: Steps the scanlines with the second edge's slope and calls the row-drawing routine from a table for each span inside the screen width.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(de)/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(De).adf:Frontier:5:19A24
name: fill_scanlines_span_clip
description: Steps two edges down the scanlines, clipping each span to the screen width before calling the row-drawing routine from a table.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(de)/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(De).adf:Frontier:5:19A84
name: fill_scanlines_from_x_edges
description: Fills rows between two x-positioned edges, drawing each span that lies inside the screen width through a table-selected row routine.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(de)/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(De).adf:Frontier:5:19A8A
name: fill_scanlines_alt_slope
description: Walks the scanlines using the alternate slope and row routine, skipping spans that fall outside the screen width.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(de)/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(De).adf:Frontier:5:19AB4
name: fill_scanlines_single_edge
description: Steps one edge down the scanlines and calls the row routine for each span inside the screen width until the row count is exhausted.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(de)/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(De).adf:Frontier:5:19AF4
name: sort_vertices_by_height
description: Sorts three vertices by their vertical coordinate, then reloads the edge positions for the scanline fill.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(de)/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(De).adf:Frontier:5:19B22
name: compute_edge_slopes_fixed
description: Computes the fixed-point slopes for the two edges of a span by dividing horizontal by vertical differences with sign-corrected rounding, storing each step for the scanline fill.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(de)/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(De).adf:Frontier:5:19B40
name: compute_edge_slope_pair
description: Computes a pair of fixed-point edge steps from the horizontal and vertical differences of a span, handling the zero vertical case as a direct shift.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(de)/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(De).adf:Frontier:5:19B46
name: compute_second_slope_step
description: Computes the second fixed-point edge step from a span's differences, using a shift when the vertical difference is zero and a sign-corrected division otherwise.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(de)/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(De).adf:Frontier:5:19B72
name: fill_scanlines_bounded_top
description: Steps the scanline edges within a top bound, calling the row routine for each span inside the screen width and stopping when the row count runs out.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(de)/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(De).adf:Frontier:5:19B78
name: fill_scanlines_bounded_alt
description: Repeats the bounded scanline fill with the second edge slope, calling the row routine for each in-range span.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(de)/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(De).adf:Frontier:5:19BBA
name: fill_scanlines_edge_clip
description: Clips the two edge positions to the screen, then steps down the scanlines and calls the row routine for each span inside the screen width.
